name: GOV optional: admin wallet tripwire (any token sent)
description: Admin wallet tripwire: any ERC20 token sent out of a wallet tagged mf-admin-wallets (the admin EOAs and Safes, added to the project as wallets). Direction sent, netted per transaction, so flash-loan round trips stay quiet. Only tokens with a USD price count, so spam and airdropped tokens and fake Transfer logs of look-alike tokens do not fire it. Native MON is not covered. Send it to Slack or Email: the Web3 Action payload does not carry the matched transfers.
